Three parts

# Pantheon Sōshinden (総神殿) based on Shinden
# Devotional temple (崇敬) based on Kashiko Dokoro
# Ancestral hall based on Kōreiden (皇霊殿)

== Three Palace sanctuaries arrangement ==

* '''Center:''' '''Kashikodokoro (賢所)''' – the most sacred, enshrining the mirror of Amaterasu.
* '''Left (from the emperor’s perspective facing them):''' '''Kōreiden (皇霊殿)''' – the hall for the spirits of past emperors (imperial ancestors).

* '''Right (from the emperor’s perspective):''' '''Shinden (神殿)''' – the hall for other kami of the realm.[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
